program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const mass = inputs.mass; const t = Math.max(0, time); const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const height = Math.max(0, launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t); const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const acceleration = -gravity; const force = mass * gravity; let motionState = "Ready to toss"; if (t > 0) { if (height <= 0 && t > 0.1) { motionState = "Back at launch height"; } else if (Math.abs(velocity) < 0.05) { motionState = "At the top"; } else if (velocity > 0) { motionState = "Rising"; } else { motionState = "Falling"; } } const laneWidth = 300; const plotWidth = 300; const startX = 30; const startY = 50; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: startX, y: startY, w: laneWidth, h: 320, title: "Motion", state: motionState })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: startX + 50, y: startY + 280, length: 220, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0], label: "Height", unit: "m" })); const ballY = startY + 280 - (height / 2.2) * 220; objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", startX + 150, ballY, 24, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: startX + 175, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: startX + 195, y: ballY }, { value: acceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(startX + 215, ballY - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(velocity) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(acceleration) + " m/s^2", "Fg: " + sdk.format(force) + " N"], { id: "callout.toss" })); const plotX = startX + laneWidth + 20; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: plotX, y: startY, w: plotWidth, h: 320, title: "Velocity over time", state: "v = u - gt" })); const points = sdk.sample((currT) => launchSpeed - gravity * currT, 0, Math.min(1.666, 2 * apexTime), 20); objects.push(sdk.plot("plot.vt", { x: plotX + 30, y: startY + 40, w: plotWidth - 40, h: 240, axes: { x: { label: "Time", min: 0, max: 1.8, unit: "s" }, y: { label: "Velocity", min: -5.5, max: 5.5, unit: "m/s" } }, series: [{ label: "v(t)", kind: "line", points: points.map(([xt, yt]) => ({ x: xt, y: yt })) }] })); objects.push(sdk.text("plot.vt.note", plotX + 50, startY + 295, "Slope a = -g", { role: "neutral" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: objects, readouts: [{ id: "velocity", value: velocity }, { id: "acceleration", value: acceleration }, { id: "force", value: force }, { id: "motionState", value: motionState }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, mass, apexTime, apexHeight, height, velocity, acceleration, force } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity. Nonzero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero, but acceleration and gravitational force remain constant. Mass changes force without altering motion.
manifest.description: A simulation showing a ball tossed vertically. The left panel shows the height, velocity vector, acceleration vector, and readouts. The right panel shows the velocity-time graph with constant slope.
assumptions: No air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. Compare readings or adjust mass while paused.
